Manage documents

Usage:
  kernel document [command]

Available Commands:
  create      Create a document
  duplicate   Duplicate a document
  get         Get document info
  info        Get document info
  list        List documents in a notebook
  move        Move a document to another notebook
  remove      Remove a document
  rename      Rename a document
  search      Search documents by keyword

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for document

Global Flags:
      --dry-run            dry run mode: validate and print what would happen without making changes
  -f, --format string      output format: table | json (default "table")
  -v, --log-level string   log level: off | trace | debug | info | warn | error | fatal (defaults to conf.json system.logLevel)
  -w, --workspace string   workspace path

Use "kernel document [command] --help" for more information about a command.
